run_cli_structured_outputs: run the CLI to test vLLM structured outputs with choice, regex, json, grammar, and structural tag constraints
run_cli_json_schema_output: run the CLI to generate a JSON response matching a Pydantic schema with brand, model, and car_type fields
run_cli_regex_constraint: run the CLI to generate text matching a regex pattern for email addresses
run_cli_grammar_constraint: run the CLI to generate SQL queries constrained by a custom context-free grammar
run_cli_structural_tag: run the CLI to generate function calls using structural tags with a JSON parameter schema
